sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: We begin with an unsolved murder mystery.
sentences.zh: 我们从一桩未解的谋杀悬案说起。

sentences.en: Actually, a series of unsolved murders.
sentences.zh: 确切地说，是一系列谋杀悬案。

sentences.en: Perhaps the work of the United States' first serial killer.
sentences.zh: 这或许是美国首位连环杀手的杰作。

sentences.en: Before Jack the Ripper terrorized London,
sentences.zh: 在开膛手杰克在伦敦制造恐怖之前，

sentences.en: before H.H.
sentences.zh: 在 H.H.

sentences.en: Holmes stalked the Chicago World's Fair,
sentences.zh: 霍姆斯在芝加哥世博会四处寻觅之前，

sentences.en: Austin, Texas, was haunted by the servant girl annihilator.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州奥斯汀市曾被“侍女灭绝者”阴魂不散地笼罩。

sentences.en: Producer Avery Truffleman would like to reiterate that these murders are unsolved.
sentences.zh: 制作人艾弗里·特鲁弗尔曼想重申，这些谋杀案至今未破。

sentences.en: So it's possible that these were individual murders rather than the work of one man.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些也可能是独立的谋杀，而非出自一人之手。

sentences.en: The hard, fast fact is this.
sentences.zh: 铁一般的事实是这样的。

sentences.en: In 1885, eight women, mostly black servants, were brutally murdered in the dark of night.
sentences.zh: 1885年，八名女性——大多是黑人女佣——在黑夜中惨遭杀害。

sentences.en: And the night was very dark in Austin in 1885.
sentences.zh: 1885年的奥斯汀，夜晚黑得伸手不见五指。

sentences.en: There was essentially no street lighting.
sentences.zh: 基本上没有任何路灯。

sentences.en: The darkness of just life after sundown in the 19th century
sentences.zh: 19世纪日落之后那种纯粹的黑暗，

sentences.en: is something that modern people are just completely unfamiliar with.
sentences.zh: 是现代人完全无法想象的。

sentences.en: This is Bruce Hunt.
sentences.zh: 这位是布鲁斯·亨特。

sentences.en: He's an associate professor of the history of physics and technology
sentences.zh: 他是物理与技术史副教授，

sentences.en: at the University of Texas, Austin.
sentences.zh: 就职于德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校。

sentences.en: Basically, there was no outdoor lighting.
sentences.zh: 基本上，当时没有任何户外照明。

sentences.en: There was moonlight.
sentences.zh: 只有月光。

sentences.en: When the moon was out, that was about it.
sentences.zh: 当月亮出来时，也就仅此而已了。

sentences.en: And in 1894, the city of Austin decided to buy more moonlight
sentences.zh: 于是在1894年，奥斯汀市决定购买更多的“月光”，

sentences.en: in the form of towers.
sentences.zh: 以高塔的形式呈现。

sentences.en: They're called moonlight towers because they were supposed to approximate a full moon.
sentences.zh: 它们被称为月光塔，因为它们旨在模拟满月的效果。

sentences.en: Austin adopted moonlight towers, which really were towers.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀采用了月光塔，它们确实是名副其实的高塔。

sentences.en: They were 15 stories high, very industrial-looking, made of metal scaffolding,
sentences.zh: 它们有15层楼高，极具工业感，由金属脚手架搭成，

sentences.en: and each was crowned with a circle of six lights soaring way, way high above the city.
sentences.zh: 每座塔的顶端都饰有一圈六盏灯，高高地耸立在城市上空。

sentences.en: Austin wasn't the first to implement tower lighting.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀并不是第一个采用高塔照明的城市。

sentences.en: In the 1800s, a lot of major cities had them.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪，许多大城市都有这种装置。

sentences.en: Arclight towers illuminated streets in New York, Baltimore, L.A., San Jose, and Detroit.
sentences.zh: 弧光灯塔照亮了纽约、巴尔的摩、洛杉矶、圣何塞和底特律的街道。

sentences.en: Detroit had a very huge system, much larger than Austin ever had.
sentences.zh: 底特律曾拥有规模庞大的系统，比奥斯汀历来的规模大得多。

sentences.en: And that's actually where Austin got their moonlight towers.
sentences.zh: 事实上，奥斯汀的月光塔正是从那里引进的。

sentences.en: In 1894, the city purchased 31 of them from the city of Detroit.
sentences.zh: 1894年，该市从底特律市购买了31座这样的高塔。

sentences.en: And despite their romantic name, the absurdly tall moonlight towers
sentences.zh: 尽管名字充满浪漫色彩，但高得离谱的月光塔

sentences.en: were actually a very practical design.
sentences.zh: 实际上是一种非常实用的设计。

sentences.en: They're not meant to look cool.
sentences.zh: 它们的目的不是为了好看。

sentences.en: They're very functional.
sentences.zh: 它们功能性极强。

sentences.en: And their height was meant to accommodate the lighting they used.
sentences.zh: 其高度是为了适应它们所使用的照明设备。

sentences.en: They're arc lights.
sentences.zh: 它们是弧光灯。

sentences.en: They initially were arc lights.
sentences.zh: 最初使用的就是弧光灯。

sentences.en: Carbon arc lights, the precursor to the incandescent bulb.
sentences.zh: 碳弧灯，白炽灯的前身。

sentences.en: Arc lights are basically a continued spark between two carbon electrodes.
sentences.zh: 弧光灯基本上是两个碳电极之间持续产生的电火花。

sentences.en: They're extremely bright.
sentences.zh: 它们极其耀眼。

sentences.en: A lot of glare.
sentences.zh: 眩光非常强烈。

sentences.en: They're the sort of thing you use in a searchlight.
sentences.zh: 这是你在探照灯里会用到的那种东西。

sentences.en: And if you put arc lights at street level, that's blinding.
sentences.zh: 如果你把弧光灯放在街道高度，那简直会把人亮瞎。

sentences.en: Well, the solution to that was to put it up high enough that you'd spread the light out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，解决的办法就是把它架得足够高，以便把光线散开。

sentences.en: But even on their high tower, the arc lights were still so bright.
sentences.zh: 但即使在高高的塔上，弧光灯依然非常刺眼。

sentences.en: I mean, they'd be bright by today's standards.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，按今天的标准来看，它们也很亮。

sentences.en: But then imagine what that would look like to you if you were an Austinite in the 1890s,
sentences.zh: 但试想一下，如果你是19世纪90年代的奥斯汀居民，

sentences.en: accustomed to pitch black streets and gas lamps.
sentences.zh: 习惯了漆黑的街道和煤气灯，看到这个会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: A gas lamp has the power of about 15 candles.
sentences.zh: 一盏煤气灯的亮度大约相当于15支蜡烛。

sentences.en: An arc light has the power of a couple thousand.
sentences.zh: 而一盏弧光灯的亮度相当于几千支。

sentences.en: It was a very intense light, almost two months light.
sentences.zh: 那是一种非常强烈的光，几乎相当于两个月的月光。

sentences.en: People would go out and enjoy the light,
sentences.zh: 人们会外出享受这种光线，

sentences.en: but they would bring umbrellas in order to shield themselves from the glare.
sentences.zh: 但他们会带上雨伞来为自己遮挡刺眼的强光。

sentences.en: This is Ernest Freeberg, head of the history department at the University of Tennessee-Knoxville.
sentences.zh: 这位是田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校历史系主任欧内斯特·弗里伯格。

sentences.en: He's also the author of the book The Age of Edison, Electric Light and the Invention of Modern America.
sentences.zh: 他也是《爱迪生时代：电灯与现代美国的创造》一书的作者。

sentences.en: And the glare was just one of the problems with arc lights.
sentences.zh: 强光只是弧光灯带来的问题之一。

sentences.en: There were a few other downsides.
sentences.zh: 还有其他一些缺点。

sentences.en: One was that it sounded like a swarm of angry bees.
sentences.zh: 其中一个缺点是它听起来像一群愤怒的蜜蜂。

sentences.en: It would buzz and as these carbons burned,
sentences.zh: 它会发出嗡嗡声，而且随着这些碳棒燃烧，

sentences.en: they would drop shreds of ash, burning ash down on people down below.
sentences.zh: 它们会将炭屑——燃烧着的炭屑——洒落在下方的人们身上。

sentences.en: So there's a drawback.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个弊端。

sentences.en: Even with their blinding glare and nefarious hum and deposits of molten ash,
sentences.zh: 尽管有耀眼的眩光、讨厌的嗡嗡声以及飘落的熔渣，

sentences.en: carbon arc lights were still so exciting.
sentences.zh: 碳弧灯依然让人感到无比兴奋。

sentences.en: They created a whole new world for people accustomed to dim and dark cities.
sentences.zh: 对于习惯了昏暗和黑暗城市的居民来说，它们创造了一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: Because bright electric light can highlight certain things
sentences.zh: 因为明亮的电光可以突出显示某些事物，

sentences.en: that you might not even notice in the full light of day.
sentences.zh: 这些事物在白天的全光照下你甚至可能注意不到。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of great discussion about seeing the grass in a totally different way.
sentences.zh: 因此，当时有很多关于以完全不同的方式观察草地的精彩讨论。

sentences.en: People love to look at their hands under the arc light in the dark
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢在黑暗中借着弧光端详自己的双手，

sentences.en: and they were seeing the details of their hands in new ways.
sentences.zh: 他们以全新的方式观察到手部细节。

sentences.en: Dude.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So it was really a change in perception that was thrilling.
sentences.zh: 因此，这确实是一种令人兴奋的感知上的转变。

sentences.en: And also the thrilling feeling of being out at night and feeling safe
sentences.zh: 还有夜间出门并感到安全的激动心情，

sentences.en: because visibility equals safety.
sentences.zh: 因为看得见就等于安全。

sentences.en: Some cities thought that these newfangled streetlights
sentences.zh: 一些城市认为这些新奇的路灯

sentences.en: were going to cut back on the need for police
sentences.zh: 将减少对警察的需求，

sentences.en: or even eliminate law enforcement entirely.
sentences.zh: 甚至彻底消除执法部门。

sentences.en: If you could set up an arc light in the middle of a town square,
sentences.zh: 如果你能在城镇广场中央装上一盏弧光灯，

sentences.en: you'd sort of be returning the square to the public
sentences.zh: 你就等于把广场还给了公众，

sentences.en: and take it away from criminals and ne'er-do-wells
sentences.zh: 将其从那些在阴影中流连忘返的罪犯和无赖手中夺了回来，

sentences.en: who were hanging around in the shadows by driving out the shadows.
sentences.zh: 通过驱散阴影来赶走他们。

sentences.en: People called the arc lights policemen on a pole
sentences.zh: 人们把弧光灯称为“杆子上的警察”，

sentences.en: and they allowed for a whole new kind of nightlife.
sentences.zh: 它们催生了一种全新类型的夜生活。

sentences.en: Many people were very excited to go out
sentences.zh: 许多人非常兴奋地出门，

sentences.en: and attend a fancy ball under the arc light.
sentences.zh: 参加在弧光下举办的高级舞会。

sentences.en: But once they got there,
sentences.zh: 但一旦他们到了那里，

sentences.en: they realized that this harsh blue light
sentences.zh: 他们才意识到这种刺眼的蓝光

sentences.en: highlighted every one of their imperfections.
sentences.zh: 暴露了他们身上的每一处瑕疵。

sentences.en: So every gray hair and wrinkle,
sentences.zh: 因此，面对每一根白发和每一道皱纹，

sentences.en: many people vowed that they would never again go near electric light.
sentences.zh: 许多人发誓再也不靠近电灯了。

sentences.en: Vanity aside,
sentences.zh: 抛开虚荣心不谈，

sentences.en: everyone was kind of nervous about the general idea of light at night.
sentences.zh: 大家对夜晚有光这一总体概念其实都有些不安。

sentences.en: "'Twas unnatural," they decreed.
sentences.zh: “这太不自然了，”他们断言。

sentences.en: The towers could cause sleeplessness,
sentences.zh: 这些高塔会导致失眠，

sentences.en: cast eerie shadows,
sentences.zh: 投下诡异的阴影，

sentences.en: crops would overproduce,
sentences.zh: 导致农作物产量过剩，

sentences.en: hens would overlay.
sentences.zh: 母鸡会过度下蛋。

sentences.en: There were stories that the arc lights
sentences.zh: 有传言说，弧光灯

sentences.en: lured restless alligators to the shore
sentences.zh: 把焦躁不安的短吻鳄引诱到岸边，

sentences.en: and attracted biblical proportions of crickets,
sentences.zh: 还招来了数量堪称《圣经》中灾难般的蟋蟀，

sentences.en: according to the Austin Statesman in 1921.
sentences.zh: 据1921年的《奥斯汀政治报》报道。

sentences.en: "'Egypt has nothing on central Texas when it comes to scourges.
sentences.zh: “说到灾难，德克萨斯州中部可比埃及有过之而无不及。

sentences.en: After the recent flood came the crickets,
sentences.zh: 继最近的洪水之后，蟋蟀接踵而至，

sentences.en: tempted by the beams of light to settle in illuminated vicinities.'"
sentences.zh: 在光束的诱惑下，它们在灯火通明的地区安家落户。”

sentences.en: Bruce Hunt suspects that these reports were overblown.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯·亨特怀疑这些报道言过其实。

sentences.en: "'Eh, you know,
sentences.zh: “呃，你知道的，

sentences.en: I think a lot of that was kind of newspapermen joking around.'"
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多都只是报社记者在开玩笑。”

sentences.en: "'Oh, journalism was so much fun back then.'"
sentences.zh: “哦，当年的新闻业太有趣了。”

sentences.en: But the biggest problem with the towers
sentences.zh: 但这些高塔最大的问题

sentences.en: was that their height made them a drag to maintain.
sentences.zh: 在于它们的高度导致维护起来极其费劲。

sentences.en: The arcs burned down the carbon electrodes very rapidly,
sentences.zh: 电弧会非常迅速地烧毁碳电极，

sentences.en: so you had to go up and change them about once a day.
sentences.zh: 所以你大约一天得上去更换一次。

sentences.en: And I cannot emphasize enough how super tall these things are.
sentences.zh: 我怎么强调都不为过，这些东西实在是太高了。

sentences.en: As tall as a 15-story building.
sentences.zh: 足有一栋15层楼那么高。

sentences.en: And if you look at one of Austin's moonlight towers,
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看奥斯汀的一座月光塔，

sentences.en: there's a rickety little pulley-type thing in the center of it.
sentences.zh: 会发现它的正中心有一个摇摇晃晃的小滑轮装置。

sentences.en: It's like a dumbwaiter apparatus.
sentences.zh: 就像一个送餐电梯装置。

sentences.en: And supposedly the guy would stand on that
sentences.zh: 据说那个人会站在上面，

sentences.en: and pull himself up
sentences.zh: 把自己拉上去，

sentences.en: to go up and change the carbon electrodes every day.
sentences.zh: 每天上去更换碳电极。

sentences.en: That's a nuisance and an expense.
sentences.zh: 这既是个麻烦，又是一笔开销。

sentences.en: And so as soon as they could, really,
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦条件允许，确切地说，

sentences.en: by the 1920s,
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪20年代，

sentences.en: the city replaced the arc lights,
sentences.zh: 该市便将弧光灯

sentences.en: the carbon arcs,
sentences.zh: ——那些碳弧灯——

sentences.en: with big incandescent bulbs,
sentences.zh: 更换成了大型白炽灯泡，

sentences.en: which were not as bright,
sentences.zh: 虽然亮度不如从前，

sentences.en: but were a lot easier to maintain.
sentences.zh: 但维护起来要容易得多。

sentences.en: But while Austin was futzing around with different bulbs,
sentences.zh: 不过，正当奥斯汀折腾着各种灯泡时，

sentences.en: most other cities had already removed their tower lights completely.
sentences.zh: 大多数其他城市已经彻底拆除了它们的灯塔。

sentences.en: Every place else abandoned them by about the 1920s,
sentences.zh: 其他所有地方在大约20世纪20年代之前就都放弃了它们，

sentences.en: but Austin kept them.
sentences.zh: 但奥斯汀却保留了下来。

sentences.en: Austin had fallen on hard times,
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀曾陷入困境，

sentences.en: and the city couldn't afford to tear down the towers.
sentences.zh: 这座城市无力承担拆除高塔的费用。

sentences.en: And so they just stayed.
sentences.zh: 所以它们就这样留了下来。

sentences.en: And to this day, 17 of the original 31 survive.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，最初的31座高塔中仍有17座幸存。

sentences.en: The last of the moonlight towers.
sentences.zh: 这是最后的月光塔。

sentences.en: Although today, without the arc lights,
sentences.zh: 尽管如今没有了弧光灯，

sentences.en: the moonlight towers have a kind of weak and distant glow.
sentences.zh: 月光塔发出的光芒显得有些微弱而遥远。

sentences.en: They're easy to ignore.
sentences.zh: 它们很容易被忽视。

sentences.en: But you might know them from a little movie
sentences.zh: 但你可能会从一部名为

sentences.en: called Dazed and Confused.
sentences.zh: 《年少轻狂》的小电影中知道它们。

sentences.en: Dazed and Confused is set in Austin in 1976.
sentences.zh: 《年少轻狂》以1976年的奥斯汀为背景。

sentences.en: In the movie, a bunch of kids party and drive around
sentences.zh: 在电影中，一群年轻人聚会并四处兜风，

sentences.en: until they all gather at the end by a moonlight tower.
sentences.zh: 直到最后他们都聚集在月光塔旁。

sentences.en: There's a new fiesta in the making as we speak.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，一场新的狂欢正在酝酿之中。

sentences.en: It's out at the moon tower.
sentences.zh: 它耸立在月亮塔那里。

sentences.en: In the movie Dazed and Confused,
sentences.zh: 在电影《年少轻狂》中，

sentences.en: a Richard Linklater movie,
sentences.zh: 一部理查德·林克莱特执导的电影，

sentences.en: Matthew McConaughey says,
sentences.zh: 马修·麦康纳说道，

sentences.en: party at the moon tower.
sentences.zh: 月亮塔派对。

sentences.en: But they're moonlight towers.
sentences.zh: 但它们其实是月光塔。

sentences.en: In real life, people don't actually go there to party.
sentences.zh: 在现实生活中，人们其实并不会去那里开派对。

sentences.en: Most of them are just in sort of like parking lots or something.
sentences.zh: 它们大都位于停车场之类的场所。

sentences.en: I went to a moonlight tower on the side of a busy road,
sentences.zh: 我曾去过一个位于一条繁忙马路边的月光塔，

sentences.en: on the corner of 9th and Guadalupe.
sentences.zh: 在第九街和瓜达卢佩街的转角处。

sentences.en: It's not Guadalupe, it's Guadalupe.
sentences.zh: 不是瓜达卢佩，是瓜达卢佩。

sentences.en: Clearly, I needed a local's help.
sentences.zh: 很显然，我需要当地人的帮助。

sentences.en: My name's Wiley Wiggins.
sentences.zh: 我叫威利·维金斯。

sentences.en: I'm 38 years old.
sentences.zh: 我38岁。

sentences.en: I was born and raised in Austin, Texas.
sentences.zh: 我在德克萨斯州奥斯汀出生并长大。

sentences.en: And in the early 90s, I was in a movie by Richard Linklater called Dazed and Confused.
sentences.zh: 在90年代初，我参演了理查德·林克莱特的一部名为《年少轻狂》的电影。

sentences.en: He played the freshman Mitch Kramer, who wonders about the moon towers.
sentences.zh: 他饰演大一新生米奇·克雷默，对月亮塔充满了好奇。

sentences.en: What's it called, the moon tower, anyway?
sentences.zh: 这叫什么来着，反正就是月亮塔？

sentences.en: Uh, I guess they just decided to put it up out here whenever they were building the power plant.
sentences.zh: 呃，我想他们当初建发电厂的时候，就决定把它立在这儿了。

sentences.en: Actually, it's a good idea.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这倒是个好主意。

sentences.en: I mean, you got a full moon out here every day of the year, you know?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你一年到头每天都能在这儿看到满月，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And then they all climb up the moon tower.
sentences.zh: 然后他们全都爬上了月亮塔。

sentences.en: This place used to be off limits, man, because some drunk freshman fell off.
sentences.zh: 这个地方以前是禁区，老兄，因为有个喝醉的大一新生从上面摔了下来。

sentences.en: You went right down the middle, smacking his head on every beam, man.
sentences.zh: 你直接从中间掉了下去，每个横梁上都撞到了脑袋，老兄。

sentences.en: I hear it doesn't hurt after the first couple, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我听说摔过前两下之后就不怎么疼了。

sentences.en: In real life, these moonlight towers would be really hard to climb,
sentences.zh: 在现实中，这些月光塔其实很难攀爬，

sentences.en: which is why, for this scene, Richard Linklater made a fake moonlight tower.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，为了拍摄这个场景，理查德·林克莱特制作了一个假月光塔。

sentences.en: The one in the movie had a ladder, not the pulley thing,
sentences.zh: 电影里的那个装有梯子，而不是滑轮装置，

sentences.en: and it was nowhere near as tall as a real moonlight tower.
sentences.zh: 而且它的高度跟真正的月光塔相比简直相去甚远。

sentences.en: And I'm terrified of heights.
sentences.zh: 而我有恐高症。

sentences.en: Wiley would have never tried this stunt.
sentences.zh: 威利是绝对不会尝试这种特技的。

sentences.en: No one he knew actually did.
sentences.zh: 他认识的人里也没有人真的试过。

sentences.en: When I was a kid, there was always somebody who knew somebody who knew somebody who had climbed it.
sentences.zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，总有人认识某个人，而那个人又认识爬过塔的人。

sentences.en: It's unclear how many times this was ever attempted, but in any case, stories abound.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚历史上究竟有多少人尝试过，但无论如何，各种传说层出不穷。

sentences.en: And there was a point when Austin considered finally taking these old lights down,
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，奥斯汀甚至考虑最终把这些旧灯拆除，

sentences.en: just like all the other cities had done.
sentences.zh: 就像其他所有城市做的那样。

sentences.en: In the 50s and 60s, the attitude was, well, these are out of date, and we're going to pull those down.
sentences.zh: 在50和60年代，人们的态度是，这些东西已经过时了，我们要把它们拆掉。

sentences.en: In fact, I've got a video that I found online that was a sort of little historical vignettes of Austin
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在网上找到了一段视频，那是一组关于奥斯汀的历史小片段，

sentences.en: that was made by one of the local TV stations in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 由当地的一家电视台在20世纪60年代制作。

sentences.en: Tonight, Progress Report Austin presents The Legends of Austin.
sentences.zh: 今晚，《奥斯汀进度报告》为您呈现《奥斯汀传奇》。

sentences.en: And he said, here's the moonlight towers, and here they show.
sentences.zh: 他说，这就是月光塔，它们就是这样展现的。

sentences.en: The romance of these moonlight towers will disappear in a few years.
sentences.zh: 这些月光塔的浪漫气息将在几年内消失。

sentences.en: There are 29 of these towers left, each 150 feet high, with mercury vapor lamps of 9,000 candle power.
sentences.zh: 这里还剩下29座这样的塔，每座高150英尺，配备9000烛光的汞蒸气灯。

sentences.en: Now, they're out of date now, and no doubt will soon disappear.
sentences.zh: 如今它们已经过时，毫无疑问很快就会消失。

sentences.en: Modern times and new improvements in lighting have made these inefficient for providing light to our city at night.
sentences.zh: 现代的发展和照明技术的新改进，使得这些塔在夜间为城市提供照明变得效率低下。

sentences.en: And it's a shame for anyone who has walked into their glow on a fall evening,
sentences.zh: 而对于任何在秋天的傍晚走入它们的光晕中、

sentences.en: watching the shadows around him, knows the beauty they have provided.
sentences.zh: 看着身旁剪影的人来说，这是一种遗憾，他们深知这些灯光所带来的美。

sentences.en: And there's that sort of tone that that's, well, a little remnant of our past that we will lose soon.
sentences.zh: 当时就是这种调调，觉得这不过是我们很快就会失去的过去的一点残余。

sentences.en: Well, people just said, why should we lose it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们只是在说，我们为什么要失去它？

sentences.en: Keep them up.
sentences.zh: 留着它们。

sentences.en: So the towers were inducted into the National Registry of Historic Places in 1976.
sentences.zh: 于是这些塔在1976年被列入《国家史迹名录》。

sentences.en: Some of the towers even have plaques.
sentences.zh: 其中一些塔甚至还挂有铭牌。

sentences.en: And Austin's power provider, Austin Energy, funnels a lot of resources into maintaining the towers.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀的电力供应商奥斯汀能源公司投入了大量资源来维护这些塔。

sentences.en: Take it from Austin Energy spokesman Carlos Cordova.
sentences.zh: 听听奥斯汀能源公司发言人卡洛斯·科尔多瓦怎么说。

sentences.en: Right now, what's really interesting about the moonlight towers is they're going to be going through a renovation.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于月光塔真正有趣的是，它们即将经历一次翻新。

sentences.en: And this renovation is a total drag because these towers are in the National Registry of Historic Places.
sentences.zh: 而这次翻新简直是个巨大的麻烦，因为这些塔被列入了《国家史迹名录》。

sentences.en: They have to be restored to their original form.
sentences.zh: 它们必须被恢复到最初的形态。

sentences.en: So we can't go to Home Depot or Lowe's and buy bolts and nuts.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不能去家得宝或劳氏五金店买螺栓和螺母。

sentences.en: The contractor has to cast bolts and parts that look exactly identical to the original so he can keep its historic designation.
sentences.zh: 承包商必须铸造出与原件完全一模一样的螺栓和零件，才能保留其历史文物的称号。

sentences.en: That's what I love about these moonlight towers, man.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喜欢这些月光塔的地方，老兄。

sentences.en: I get older, they stay the same age.
sentences.zh: 我日渐变老，而它们的年纪永远不变。

sentences.en: Yes, they do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes, they do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's an expensive project, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个昂贵的项目，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, it's very specialized work that, of course, affects the price.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一项非常专业的工作，当然也会影响价格。

sentences.en: But notice there wasn't any uproar from the citizens about spending this money on the moonlight towers.
sentences.zh: 但请注意，市民们并没有对在月光塔上花钱产生任何抗议。

sentences.en: Austinites are willing to put up the funds.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀人愿意为此出资。

sentences.en: The towers are this point of civic pride.
sentences.zh: 这些塔已成为一种城市自豪感的象征。

sentences.en: Every year during the holidays, Austin Energy strings Christmas lights from the Moonlight Tower in Zilker Park.
sentences.zh: 每年假期期间，奥斯汀能源公司都会从齐尔克公园的月光塔上拉起圣诞彩灯。

sentences.en: And Austinites lovingly refer to that tower as the Zilker Park Tree.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀人亲切地将这座塔称为齐尔克公园之树。

sentences.en: Austin also hosts the Moon Tower Comedy Festival, and there's a local band called Moonlight Towers.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀还举办月亮塔喜剧节，当地还有一个乐队叫月亮塔。

sentences.en: And at a restaurant, I ordered a drink called a Moonlight Tower.
sentences.zh: 在一家餐馆里，我点了一杯名为月亮塔的饮料。

sentences.en: The towers have become part of the character and folklore of Austin.
sentences.zh: 这些塔已经成为奥斯汀性格和民间传说的一部分。

sentences.en: I mean, there's all sorts of legends and stuff about them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于它们的传说各种各样。

sentences.en: Like, when I was a kid, of course, there was always a legend that somebody had climbed up on acid and fallen off and died, which is evidently not true.
sentences.zh: 比如，当我还是个孩子的时候，当然总流传着这样一个传说：有人嗑了药爬上去然后摔下来死了，显然这不是真的。

sentences.en: But then, of course, the other legend is that they were built because there was a serial killer, like in the, what, like the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 但当然，另一个传说则是它们建造的原因是因为有一个连环杀手，大约在，什么来着，19世纪左右。

sentences.en: And that one, I think, is supposed to be true, right?
sentences.zh: 那个传说我想应该是真的，对吧？

sentences.en: Have we verified this?
sentences.zh: 我们核实过这个吗？

sentences.en: The Servant Girl Annihilator story is not a myth at all.
sentences.zh: “侍女灭绝者”的故事根本不是神话。

sentences.en: It's absolutely true.
sentences.zh: 它是千真万确的。

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with the Moonlight Towers.
sentences.zh: 这和月光塔没有任何关系。

sentences.en: At least not directly.
sentences.zh: 至少没有直接关系。

sentences.en: That was all over with well before the talk about the Moonlight Towers came up.
sentences.zh: 这一切在人们谈论月光塔之前很久就已经结束了。

sentences.en: And I've never seen anything about a need for them being associated with the Servant Girl Annihilator case.
sentences.zh: 而且我从未见过任何关于需要它们与“侍女灭绝者”案有关联的说法。

sentences.en: Still, the Servant Girl Annihilator became the Genesis story that Austinites tell about these lights.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，“侍女灭绝者”还是成了奥斯汀人讲述这些灯光的起源故事。

sentences.en: And the story of the Servant Girl Annihilator does truly illustrate the limitations of 19th century nighttime.
sentences.zh: 而“侍女灭绝者”的故事确实生动地说明了19世纪夜间的局限性。

sentences.en: These carbon arc streetlamps were chasing away darkness and fear.
sentences.zh: 这些碳弧街灯曾用来驱散黑暗和恐惧。

sentences.en: And I think it's something we so easily take for granted, how liberating this is.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种解放是多么的理所当然，而我们却常常忽略了这一点。

sentences.en: How much the darkness was a permanent form of limitation on free will and human activity for us.
sentences.zh: 黑暗在多大程度上构成了对我们自由意志和人类活动的永久限制。

sentences.en: I mean, it had great benefits, of course, that we sometimes miss because we have too much light now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这当然带来了巨大的好处，由于我们现在的光线太亮，有时我们反而忽略了这一点。

sentences.en: Moonlight Towers were a strange offshoot.
sentences.zh: 月光塔是一个奇怪的分支。

sentences.en: A sort of Neanderthal in the evolution of the streetlight.
sentences.zh: 堪称街灯进化史上的某种尼安德特人。

sentences.en: And in Austin, where Keep Austin Weird is an unofficial slogan of the city, printed on bumper stickers and scrawled on bathroom walls.
sentences.zh: 在奥斯汀，“保持奥斯汀怪异”是这座城市的非官方口号，印在车尾贴纸上，涂鸦在洗手间的墙壁上。

sentences.en: You can't help but feel like the Moon Towers are doing their part.
sentences.zh: 你会忍不住觉得月光塔正在尽自己的一份力。

sentences.en: After every other city has torn their towers down, Austin holds on to theirs and preserves them.
sentences.zh: 在其他所有城市都拆掉了它们的塔之后，奥斯汀却坚守并保护着自己的塔。

sentences.en: A reminder of the time when the Texas capital was just an oddball little town that bought the Moon.
sentences.zh: 这是一个提醒，让人想起德克萨斯州首府曾是一个买下月亮的古怪小镇的时代。

sentences.en: To those who haven't looked closely, look closely soon.
sentences.zh: 对于那些没有仔细观察过的人，快去仔细看看吧。

sentences.en: For the day of the artificial moonlight is ending.
sentences.zh: 因为人造月光的时代即将结束。

sentences.en: And this site will one day disappear from our city.
sentences.zh: 这个地标终有一天会从我们的城市中消失。

sentences.en: The last in our nation with the moonlight glow from such towers.
sentences.zh: 这将是我们国家最后一处拥有这种高塔月光光晕的地方。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffelman, Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由艾弗里·特鲁费尔曼、凯蒂·明格尔、萨姆·格林斯潘以及我罗曼·马斯共同制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of KALW 91.7 San Francisco and produced out of the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山KALW 91.7的一个项目，制作于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的建筑与室内设计公司ArcSign办公室。

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢约瑟芬·希尔和马克·奥本海默对本期节目的帮助。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Josephine Hill and Mark Oppenheimer for help on this episode.
sentences.zh: 您可以在Facebook上找到并点赞本节目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我在推特上叫罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 如果您在这两个地方的任何一个关注我，您就能了解我们即将举办的所有活动、讲座和事情，

sentences.en: If you follow me in either one of those two places, you can be aware of all the things and talks and events we have coming up,
sentences.zh: 包括我将在离我家大约两英里外的一所中学体育馆里举办的一场免费公开讲座。

sentences.en: including a free public talk that I'm giving in a middle school gym about two miles from my house.
sentences.zh: 对此我感到兴奋不已。

sentences.en: So excited about that one.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还有一个很酷的Tumblr和一个Spotify播放列表。

sentences.en: Plus, we have a cool Tumblr, a Spotify playliSt.
sentences.zh: 我们在Instagram上也有账号，但我鼓励您访问99pi.org，去探索《99%隐形》的整个世界。

sentences.en: We're on Instagram, but I encourage you to explore the entire world of 99% Invisible at 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 无线电乌托邦。

sentences.zh: RadioTopia
